standard-dialogue.npc: Are you a cook? I need more staff.

steps.npc: This is the Hosidius Mess. It was set up to help feed the soldiers from the Shayzien Encampment. Much better than anything they can cook over there.

steps.player: How come it's so far from Hosidius?

steps.npc: The solders do enough hard work, so it seemed only right not to make them walk all the way across Kourend for a bit of food.
Anyway, enough chatting. Are you a cook?

options.text: Yeah, I can do some cooking.

steps.player: Yeah, I can do some cooking. Well, my level's [number<20], anyway.

steps.npc: Hah! You'll need a level of 20 to cook anything for these soldiers. They're picky about what they eat.

steps.player: Yeah, I can do some cooking.

steps.text: If the player does not have enough Hosidius Favour:

steps.npc: Good. When you've got more Hosidius favour, come back and I'll have plenty for you to do.

steps.text: If the player has enough Hosidius Favour:

steps.npc: Good. The soldiers like stew, meat pies and pineapple pizza. You'll find ingredients in the cupboards.
When you've made something, put it on the buffet tables, and you'll gain experience based on how much the soldiers appreciate them.

attempting-to-serve-food-or-take-servery.npc: You're not authorised to work in my kitchen.

attempting-to-serve-servery-ingredients.npc: They're not going to eat anything you've got there. Make them meat pies, stew or pineapple pizza.

serving-meat-pie-pineapple-pizza-or-stew.npc: They're not going to eat that. Use the ingredients provided here.
They're not going to eat that. Make them meat pies, stew or pineapple pizza.

treasure-trails-master-with-inventory-sp.text: You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.

treasure-trails-master-with-no-inventory.npc: Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
